Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with right knee pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has had right knee pain for the past 2 weeks.
Patient is training for a marathon and currently runs 7–8 miles a few times per week.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Training for marathon. Currently up to 7-8 miles few times a week.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient goes to the gym several times per week.
This week the patient had to stop running at the 20-minute mark because of knee pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Had to stop running at 20 min point due to pain this week.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Pain is located at the front and right side of the knee.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Pain in front of knee and right side.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports no specific area of tenderness.
Patient noted puffiness of the knee after exercise that settled completely with ice.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has noticed puffiness of knee after exercise, used ice and this settled completely.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies any giving way or locking of the knee.
Patient has no difficulty going up or down stairs or walking normally.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No problems going up/downstairs or on normal walking.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports full range of motion in the knee.
Patient feels the knee pain is generally worsening.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Generally feels pain is getting worse.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient previously experienced an ice-hockey-related injury with bruising.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has had previous ice hockey injury and bruising afterwards.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies other joint pains and denies feeling generally unwell or febrile.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No other jt pains, no general unwell/fever.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had tingling in the right forefoot that has since resolved.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has had tingling R side forefoot which settled down.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient notes slight ankle swelling with sock indentation.
Patient reports no change in temperature or color of the ankle/foot.
Patient has no pain in the sole and no difficulty walking on hard floors.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No problems walking hard floors/pain in sole.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has undergone LASIK eye surgery.
Patient may have a history of kidney stones.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient occasionally smokes a joint (suggesting occasional cannabis use).
Patient regularly runs 7–8 miles a few times per week as part of marathon training.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Training for marathon. Currently up to 7-8 miles few times a week.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient attends the gym several times per week.

Physical_Findings.content: Right knee has full range of motion.
No specific area of tenderness noted in the right knee.
Slight ankle swelling with indentation from socks observed.

Review_of_Systems.content: Patient denies feeling generally unwell or having fever.
Patient denies gastrointestinal symptoms or asthma.
Patient denies change in temperature or color of the affected area.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribe a stronger anti-inflammatory to replace ibuprofen.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advised replace ibuprofen with stronger anti-inflammatory which I will prescribe.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise continued use of ice on the knee as much as possible.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Continue using ice as much as possible

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommend reducing exercise and avoiding running when pain is present.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: reduce exercise. Do not continue to run with pain.

Plan_of_Care.content: Refer patient to physiotherapy for assessment and ongoing treatment.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advise I will refer for physio for assessment and ongoing Rx.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient instructed to see a doctor as soon as possible if swelling, heat, redness, or locking persists.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If persistent swelling/heat/redness/locking to see Dr asap.
